worldspawn music key of maps/ce1m7.bsp, written without a file extension. Neither backend supplies one - S_AL_StartBackgroundTrack hands the value straight to S_CodecOpenStream and S_Base_StartBackgroundTrack does the same through S_OpenBackgroundStream - so S_CodecGetSound tries 'music/sonic5.<ext>' against every registered codec in search order, wav then ogg then opus, because S_CodecInit registers them the other way round and S_CodecRegister prepends (ioq3 code/client/snd_codec.c). No pinned OpenArena release ships any of them, and oa_pvomit names the same track with '.wav' written out, which does not exist either; a missing track is silence, not a failure
